autoContext: Validates writeFile action. Covers: file param (output path, supports {variable} template), content param (key name whose value is written), auto-mkdir for nested paths, and return value (the resolved output path stored under action id).

prepare._comment: Produce content to write — stored under id 'report_content'.
Produce a timestamp for use in the templated filename.

write_plain._comment: PARAM: file — plain output path. Parent dirs are created automatically (makedirs). PARAM: content — key name of the value to write (must be in previous_data).

write_templated_path._comment: PARAM: file with {variable} template — resolved via _SafeMap before writing. Allows dynamic filenames incorporating timestamps, labels, etc.

verify._comment: writeFile returns the resolved file path under its action id. Confirm it is available.
